name: tg-nevermore-unknown
label: Nevermore — STRAFE declare (line lane), first contact
cue: Its shadow slides off the branch without it — a straight black lane, growing.

name: tg-nevermore-known
label: Nevermore — STRAFE declare (line lane), pattern learned
cue: Its shadow slides off the branch without it — a straight black lane, growing. You know this one: The Unkind Cut strikes in a straight line. The shadow moves first. When it detaches, the lane is already chosen — MOVE OFF IT. Step OFF the strafing lane, not along it — it can't turn mid-run. It always lands after a run, hit or miss. Punish the landing.

name: tg-nightcourt-unknown
label: Night Court — DIVE declare (single moon-shadow tile), first contact
cue: No sound. The shadow on the ground is growing.

name: tg-nightcourt-known
label: Night Court — DIVE declare (single moon-shadow tile), pattern learned
cue: No sound. The shadow on the ground is growing. You know this one: Adjournment picks one target and commits — the windup tells you how to beat it. No sound is the tell. When the shadow grows, MOVE — and move again, because it's already re-aiming. Watch the ground-shadow, not the sky — the dive is silent. A missed dive comes again instantly at your new position: dodge TWICE. Then it's spent.

name: tg-bulldozer-unknown
label: Bulldozer — CHARGE declare (charge lane), first contact
cue: Lowers its head, paws the earth. Dust rises. It is not going around the tree. It has never gone around anything. It's about to break loose!

name: tg-bulldozer-known
label: Bulldozer — CHARGE declare (charge lane), pattern learned
cue: Lowers its head, paws the earth. Dust rises. It is not going around the tree. It has never gone around anything. It's about to break loose! You know this one: China-Shop Charge charges in a straight line, trampling everything in its path. It never turns. When it lowers its head, it's committed — sidestep, don't backpedal. Sidestep the lane — never try to outrun it. It never goes around.

name: tg-mirrormoth-unknown

name: tg-mirrormoth-known
label: Flashbulb Moth — FLASH declare (burst), pattern learned
cue: It lands. It folds its wings. The light in the clearing changes, like someone adjusting a lamp. It's about to break loose! You know this one: Wing Flash hits everything close around it. Wing Flash only fires FORWARD — it must face you. Circle behind it before the wings open.
